**Elite Force (Marino's Build) @VERSION@**. *Star Trek: Voyager – Elite Force*, single player, Holomatch multiplayer and experimental co-op. A native app for Apple Silicon Macs, plus experimental builds for Windows and Linux.

> **No game data is included.** You need your own copy of the game (GOG, Steam, or CD + 1.2 patch).

### Downloads
| Platform | File | How to start |
|---|---|---|
| **Mac** (Apple Silicon) | **EliteForce-MacOS-Marino-@VERSION@-arm64.dmg** (or the .zip) | Drag the app to Applications and open it. Signed and notarized by Apple. |
| **Windows** (64-bit, experimental) | **EliteForce-Marino-@VERSION@-setup.exe** (installer) or **EliteForce-Marino-@VERSION@-windows-x64.zip** | Run the installer, or unzip anywhere and run EliteForce.exe. Not code-signed yet: if SmartScreen warns, choose "More info", then "Run anyway". |
| **Linux** (x86_64, experimental, Steam Deck too) | **EliteForce-Marino-@VERSION@-x86_64.AppImage** | `chmod +x` it and run it. |

The launcher on each platform helps you point the game at your data.
